```sql
FROM hiring
JOIN evaluation ON evaluation.Employee_ID = hiring.Employee_ID
JOIN shop ON shop.Shop_ID = hiring.Shop_ID
GROUP BY employee_id

ORDER BY Number_products DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT h.District
FROM hiring h
JOIN shop s ON h.Employee_ID = s.Employee_ID
WHERE h.Shop_ID = s.Shop_ID
AND h.Is_full_time = 'T'
AND h.Start_from = s.Start_from
AND h.Employee_ID IN (SELECT Employee_ID FROM evaluation WHERE Bonus < 3000)
AND h.Employee_ID IN (SELECT Employee_ID FROM evaluation WHERE Bonus > 10000)
```
